kurz: Flour and egg are kneaded until a gluten network forms, then the dough rests so it can be rolled out.
bild_im_kopf: Like a new jumper that has to relax after washing before it fits again.
was_passiert: Kneading links the flour proteins into gluten; the egg provides water, fat and colour. At first the network makes the dough tough and springy. During resting it relaxes, and the flour fully absorbs the water.
warum_wichtig: Without resting, the dough tears or shrinks back. Fresh [[w-pasta|pasta]] cooks in 2–4 minutes because it is still moist.
faustregeln: Dough too dry? Keep kneading with wet hands rather than pouring in water.
Dough shrinks back when rolling: cover and rest for another 10 minutes.
schritte: Weigh 100 g flour (tipo 00 or half durum semolina) per egg (as a guide).
Put the egg into a well in the flour and work it in gradually.
Knead for 8–10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Wrap in film and rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out thinly, cut and cook in well-salted water for 2–4 minutes.
